title: Roger Leir's implant extractions

tellings.quote: my colleague and good friend Ellie Marculli worked with Lair and and was there when they extracted some of these implants

plain: A man named Roger Leir surgically removed objects that people believed had been implanted in their bodies, and Tim Alberino tells Michels that a colleague and good friend of his, Ellie Marculli, worked with Leir and was present when some of these implants were taken out. Alberino passes this on as something his friend saw, not something he saw himself, and does not say what the implants were or where they came from.
